# Global Intent Company

> Global Intent Company is an independent AI and systems engineering company developing language models, private AI infrastructure, and scientific computing systems.

Canonical site: https://globalintentcompany.space/

## Primary areas

- INTENT model family: https://globalintentcompany.space/intent
  Language-model research and privately operated conversational AI, including LooseMouth.
- Virtual Lab: https://globalintentcompany.space/virtual-lab
  Evidence-oriented scientific computing, simulation, instrumentation, and reproducible experimentation.
- Research: https://globalintentcompany.space/research
  Technical research dossiers, experiments, systems work, and evidence.
- Systems: https://globalintentcompany.space/systems
  Systems architecture and engineering projects.
- Software: https://globalintentcompany.space/software
  Software developed by Global Intent Company.

## Private AI infrastructure

Global Intent Company is developing PLMN (Private Language Model Node) and PLMH (Private Language Model Hub) as infrastructure for discovering, authenticating, verifying, and operating privately hosted language models.

## Evidence and provenance

Technical claims should be interpreted according to the evidence attached to the relevant research page. Experimental results, source-verified implementation details, architectural objectives, and hypotheses are intentionally distinguished.

Source organization: https://github.com/GI-Company
